metadata.scenario: A customer calls in an urgent request for immediate roof repair due to a storm. Category: Urgent Request. Flags: urgent_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. My name is Patricia Wilson, and I'm calling because my mother needs post-surgery care after her hip replacement. Of course, Patricia. When is the surgery scheduled? It’s on Thursday morning, but I’m really worried about getting care in place right after. I understand that it’s urgent. How soon after the surgery do you expect her to need assistance? Ideally, she’ll need help starting that same day, maybe for a few hours. Absolutely, we can arrange for post-surgery recovery care. What does that involve exactly? Our Post-Surgery Recovery Care includes specialized assistance with activities like mobility help, medication management, and personal care. It typically lasts 1 to 3 hours at a rate of $85 to $110. That sounds good, but is there any chance we could have someone stay longer if needed? Yes, we can always adjust the care plan based on her recovery needs. Thank you! Are the caregivers available on the same day? Yes, we can send a caregiver as soon as she returns home from surgery. Perfect! What do I need to do to set this up? I’ll need to gather some information about your mother and any special requirements. Can you provide her name and age? Yes, her name is Evelyn Wilson, and she’s 76. Thank you, Patricia. Does she have any specific medical conditions we should be aware of? Just arthritis and high blood pressure, but she manages them well. Great! I’ll also need a contact number for you and your mother’s address. My number is +13165558471, and her address is 123 Elm Street, Wichita. Thank you for that. I will schedule a caregiver for Thursday to assist her post-surgery. And what about medication management? Will someone help with that too? Yes, part of our service includes medication reminders and administration supervision. That’s a relief to hear. Will I get a confirmation email? Yes, you will receive a confirmation with all the details shortly. Thank you so much, Margaret. I really appreciate your help! You’re welcome, Patricia! If you have any further questions, feel free to reach out. I will. Thank you again! Have a great day and take care!
